# dsh-llm-arena
English | Русский
A DeepSeek Harness provider bundle for Arena API, optimized for the promotional **Arena Router** bal
ance: OpenAI Responses routing, six compact model entries, additive runtime route restoration, and a
narrow Windows Cloudflare compatibility fallback.

> [!WARNING]
> Model calls send conversation data—including prompts, system instructions, tool schem
as and results, and attachments—to Arena and potentially its selected upstream provider. Calls, retr
ies, and a fallback replay may consume credits. Installation, `dsh --profile web --dump-config`, `np
m test`, and `npm run verify` make no model calls. The optional live smoke test is potentially billa
ble and requires explicit opt-in.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> If the Arena dashboard shows funds under **Arena Router** and `$0.00` under **All m
odels**, choose `coding-router-preview` or `claude-coding-router-preview`. The four direct Claude en
tries require a nonzero **All models** balance and otherwise return HTTP `402 paid_credits_required`
ries require a nonzero **All models** balance and otherwise return HTTP `402 paid_credits_required`.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`
- Node.js 22 or newer
- An Arena API key
- PowerShell 7 (`pwsh`) onl
y when the Windows fallback is needed
Other DSH releases may work, but are not claimed compatible until separately verified.
## What the bundle adds

- Provider id: `arena`
- Protocol: `openai-responses` (not Chat Completions)
- Base URL: `https://ap

i.arena.ai/v1`
- Credential reference: `ARENA_API_KEY`
- Six preconfigured model ids
- Additive, in-

memory restoration of a missing Arena route after profile overrides
- Native-first Windows fallback
for a narrowly recognized Cloudflare block page
The bundle uses conservative fallback metadata of 262,144 context tokens, 32,768 output tokens, and
text input for models whose exact Arena limits are not publicly verified. `coding-router-preview` ca
rries the documented 1,000,000 context, 128,000 output, and text/image metadata. These are bundle ca
talog values, not an upstream service guarantee.
## Default models
| Model id | Display name | Access note |
| `coding-router-preview` | Arena Router · Coding (promo) | Recommended for promotional **Arena Rout

er** balance |
| `claude-coding-router-preview` | Arena Router · Claude (promo) | Recommended Claude

-oriented choice for promotional **Arena Router** balance |
| `claude-fable-5-1` | All models · Clau

de Fable 5.1 | Direct selection; requires **All models** balance |
| `claude-opus-5-5` | All models

· Claude Opus 5.5 | Direct selection; requires **All models** balance |
| `claude-sonnet-5-5` | All

models · Claude Sonnet 5.5 | Direct selection; requires **All models** balance |
| `claude-haiku-5-5
` | All models · Claude Haiku 5.5 | Direct selection; requires **All models** balance |
Catalog presence does not guarantee account entitlement, current availability, pricing, rate limits,
or model limits. Check the current Arena dashboard for your account.

Preferred flow:

1. Open DSH Web → Settings → Models.
2. Select **Arena API**.
3. Enter the Arena API key and apply t

## Cloudflare compatibility fallback
In default auto mode, every Arena request first uses the Fetch implementation already installed by D
default auto mode, every Arena request first uses the Fetch implementation already installed by DSH.
On Windows only, the bundle considers fallback only when the exact canonical origin `https://api.are
na.ai` returns all of the following:
loudflare block-page marker within a bounded body prefix.
Only that affected request is replayed once through a local noninteractive PowerShell 7/.NET HttpCli
ent helper. The next request starts with native Fetch again. Ordinary authentication, authorization,
application, quota, and rate-limit responses do not trigger fallback. Native network errors are not
replayed. Non-Arena origins are delegated unchanged, and macOS/Linux remain native-only.
The fallback security boundary:
- URL, method, headers, and body—including authorization—reach the local helper through stdin and pr

ocess memory, never command-line arguments or temporary request files.
- The helper receives an envi

ronment allowlist rather than the complete parent environment.
- Redirects are disabled and fail clo

sed.
- TLS verification remains enabled.
- Gzip, deflate, and Brotli are decompressed by .NET.
- SSE

bytes stream through stdout with cancellation and Node backpressure.
- Request bodies are capped at

64 MiB.
- Replay means exactly-once delivery is not guaranteed.
## Runtime route restoration
DSH profile and bundle layers can replace the complete `llm-pi-ai.providers` map. A static bundle pa
tch would therefore risk deleting providers from earlier layers.
